## Standing rules

1. FEMM auto-saves the open document when it analyzes -- always work on a scratch copy or the base model is silently mutated.
2. FEMM clears the selection after every move/rotate/scale, so the group must be re-selected before EACH operation.
3. Solve time-harmonic, never magnetostatic: at f = 0 the model reports zero induced RX voltage.
4. `config.COIL_DEPTH_MM` must equal the `[Depth]` header in the .FEM, or every absolute value is mis-scaled.
5. M is proportional to N^2 (verified); linear-in-area scaling is an unverified extrapolation.
